controls.title: Install and maintain network security controls
controls.summary: Network security controls such as firewalls and segmentation protect the cardholder data environment.

controls.title: Apply secure configurations to all system components
controls.summary: System components are configured securely; vendor defaults are changed or removed.

controls.title: Protect stored account data
controls.summary: Stored account data is minimized and rendered unreadable using strong cryptography.
implementationChecklist: Encrypt stored PAN with strong cryptography
Do not store sensitive authentication data
evidenceExamples: Weak/missing encryption, hard-coded key findings (data classification needed)

controls.title: PAN is rendered unreadable wherever stored
controls.summary: Primary account number (PAN) is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored using strong cryptography.

controls.title: Protect cardholder data with strong cryptography during transmission
controls.summary: Strong cryptography and security protocols protect PAN over open, public networks.

controls.title: Protect all systems and networks from malicious software
controls.summary: Anti-malware protection is deployed and kept current; malicious code is detected.

controls.title: Develop and maintain secure systems and software
controls.summary: Bespoke and custom software is developed securely and vulnerabilities are identified and managed throughout the lifecycle.

controls.title: Bespoke and custom software is developed securely
controls.summary: Custom software is developed based on industry standards and secure coding practices, with security incorporated throughout the SDLC.
evidenceExamples: SAST scans integrated into the SDLC

controls.title: Software engineering techniques prevent or mitigate common software attacks
controls.summary: Bespoke and custom software prevents injection, buffer overflows, insecure cryptographic storage and communications, improper error handling, XSS, CSRF, broken access control, and broken authentication.
implementationChecklist: Prevent injection, XSS, CSRF, access-control and crypto flaws
evidenceExamples: SAST findings for injection, XSS, CSRF, access control, crypto

controls.title: Security vulnerabilities are identified and managed
controls.summary: Vulnerabilities are identified from reputable sources, assigned a risk ranking, and addressed across bespoke, custom, and third-party components.
evidenceExamples: Any scanner finding with a risk score

controls.title: Inventory of bespoke, custom, and third-party software components
controls.summary: An inventory of software and third-party components is maintained to support vulnerability and patch management.

controls.title: Components are patched against known vulnerabilities
controls.summary: All system components are protected from known vulnerabilities by installing applicable security patches.

controls.title: Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks
controls.summary: Public-facing web applications are reviewed via automated or manual application vulnerability assessment tools, at least annually and after changes.
implementationChecklist: Assess web apps with automated tools
evidenceExamples: Automated SAST/DAST assessment of web apps

controls.title: Payment page scripts are managed and integrity-assured
controls.summary: All payment page scripts are authorized, integrity-assured, and inventoried.

controls.title: Restrict access to system components and cardholder data by business need to know
controls.summary: Access to cardholder data is restricted by need to know and least privilege.
implementationChecklist: Enforce least privilege and need to know

controls.title: Identify users and authenticate access to system components
controls.summary: Users are uniquely identified and strongly authenticated; credentials are protected.

controls.title: Restrict physical access to cardholder data
controls.summary: Physical access to systems and media containing cardholder data is restricted.

controls.title: Log and monitor all access to system components and cardholder data
controls.summary: Access is logged and monitored; logs are protected and reviewed.
evidenceExamples: Insufficient logging / sensitive data in logs findings

controls.title: Test security of systems and networks regularly
controls.summary: Security of systems and networks is tested regularly, including vulnerability scans and penetration testing.

controls.title: Support information security with organizational policies and programs
controls.summary: Organizational policies and programs support information security across the enterprise.
evidenceExamples: Policy and governance evidence, not SAST
